first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing signup friction and shortening onboarding can improve early adoption. This directly addresses the current funnel deterioration without repeating the known retention risk of promotional pricing. A small guarded test should measure not only completion and activation, but also qualified pipeline, retained usage, and revenue quality before broader rollout.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification test for SMB and simple-workspace accounts only. Prior evidence shows signup simplification increases activation and qualified revenue, while shortened onboarding improves completion and time-to-value. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because missing setup steps increased 60-day churn by 9% there. Monitor activation, completion, time-to-value, 30/60-day retention, qualified revenue, and segment-level effects before expanding.
